physical_address.point: A legitimate set of 81 Weyl unitary gates with nonlinear command address can fake all six basis-pair calibrations. A two-displacement composition holdout detects it.

cocycle_consistency.prediction_no_go: If an associative projective representation of additive F3^4 is exact, its central commutator is necessarily an alternating bicharacter with values in cube roots of unity. An independent nonbilinear pair phase would violate a premise, not demonstrate a new law with the same representation.

causal_order_ambiguity.formula: For pure control |+> and purification of I_d/d, control entropy is h2((1+|Tr(K)/d|)/2).
causal_order_ambiguity.formal_boundary: A central-pair switch output can be reproduced exactly by a known definite-target-order unitary with an extra control phase. It does not certify causal nonseparability. Independent trusted-operation/process-matrix or suitably extended causal witness is mandatory.
causal_order_ambiguity.literature: Araújo et al. New J. Phys. 17 102001 (2015); quantum switch does not violate standard bipartite causal inequalities without extra trust or spacetime conditions.

noisy_holdout_planning.model: IID Bernoulli two-quadrature switch phase; v=0.9, drift uniform [-.05,.05], N=160 per quadrature per setting.

boundary: Ordinary quantum circuit simulation and W33 algebra tests cannot by themselves constitute a parameter-free prediction beyond standard quantum mechanics or prove emergent Lorentzian spacetime.
